name: Galaxy Fox claim contract unprotected setMerkleRoot
summary: The unverified GFOX claim contract's setMerkleRoot had no caller check. The attacker set a root equal to its own leaf, claimed nearly the whole GFOX balance with an empty proof and sold it into the GFOX/WETH Uniswap V2 pair; two other actors repeated the same calls on the remainder within two hours.
notes: The claim contract is immutable; the owner's periodic setMerkleRoot calls and claim start time are live values the attacker overwrote or did not need, so the deployment is the reset. All other setMerkleRoot callers before the anchor were the owner.
GFOX is valued at the WETH each claimer realised from the GFOX/WETH pair (rule 15; the first dump crashed the price); the last copycat sold in the referenced follow-up transaction.
